column2: people and numbers are invented. Phone numbers use the 555-01xx fiction range.

column7: text
Dock freezer 2 sent 18 alerts on Monday night. All door openings.
Same issue on dock freezer 4. Please help us cut the door-open alerts.
Add a door-open delay setting per freezer.
Night shift muted the app again because of alert noise.
Ops manager says alert noise is the top complaint from the warehouse floor.
Still too many loading alerts on freezer 3.
Kitchen team ignores the alerts during prep. Asked for quiet hours.
Restock alerts again. Staff do not look anymore.
Prospect says their current system has so many false alarms that the team turned sound off.
Walk-in alerts fire every time the door opens during service. Too many.
Please group repeated alerts from one freezer into one message.
Audit prep still takes two days. Wants the report in the auditor's format.
Reformatting the export for our accreditation audit took most of a week.
Monthly fridge report for the state board takes hours to build.
The county inspector wants to log in and see our cooler records herself before she visits. Can she get read-only access instead of the inspection report?
Follow-up: inspector repeated the ask. She does not want a printed report or a PDF. She wants live access during the audit window.
Customer says the health department is moving to remote inspections. Inspector asked for a login to view temperature records for the last 90 days.
Our inspector asked for a live view of records, not a report. Is there an inspector or auditor login with view-only rights?
Store manager says the new county audit rules let inspectors check records remotely. They asked how an inspector could get a view-only link to the cooler data.
Repeat visit. Walk-in freezer drops off the network twice a week.
Hub placement changed for the walk-ins. Site contact J. Doe, mobile 555-0147, asked for a callback after 6 p.m.
Battery replacements again on 12 sensors. Asked about longer-life batteries.
Battery swap service question again. Staff time.
Changing batteries across 30 cold rooms is a full day of work.
Director again asks for one view across all stores.
Want a dashboard that compares all four warehouses.
Night alarm missed again. Who owns the call list after 10 p.m.?
Certificate for probe 0041 missing serial number. Please resend.
Share link for delivery temperature proof, please.
Lab wants to show its clients proof that samples stayed cold, without giving them our account.
Need a way to send a temperature record for one shipment to the sample owner.
Is the app available in Spanish for our kitchen staff?
